hero.title: AI infrastructure to power your SaaS
hero.description: Build AI agents and sell them to your customers. Each gets an isolated agent — channels, data, bill. You build the product. We run the rest.

whatIsOpenflow.title: The AI Cloud
whatIsOpenflow.description: You go to AWS to build your company. You come to OpenFlow to build the AI agents you sell. Multi-tenant agent infrastructure, from day one.

foundation.title: The Foundation: Multi-Tenant by Design
foundation.intro: One agent, many customers, zero mixing. Isolation is the default, not a feature you build.

multiTenancy.title: One agent. A hundred isolated customers.
multiTenancy.description: Sell your agent to one client or a hundred. Each gets their own conversations, channels, config, and bill. You build once. We isolate everything.

multiChannel.title: Where their audience already is
multiChannel.description: WhatsApp and web chat, live today. Instagram next. Telegram, Slack, Discord, Teams, and Google Chat on the way. One agent, every channel.

deployToYourWebsite.title: One line of code. Live on their site.
deployToYourWebsite.description: Paste a script tag — the agent is on your client's homepage. Branded, versioned, no cookies. Finished at 4:00, live at 4:05.

expensesControlPerTenant.title: Know what every customer costs you
expensesControlPerTenant.description: Spend is metered per customer, per conversation, per model call. Your margin stops being a guess. Spending caps and alerts come next.

studio.title: The Studio: Build Any Agent in Minutes
studio.intro: Where a tailored agent for a new client takes minutes, not weeks.

agentBuilder.title: A client-ready agent in minutes
agentBuilder.description: Personality, knowledge, tools, channels — defined visually, no code. New client signed this morning? Their agent ships this afternoon.

workflowBuilder.title: A script, not improv
workflowBuilder.description: Some conversations should wander. A returns process shouldn't. Agents improvise; workflows follow the script you drag onto a canvas.

agentOrchestration.title: Teams of agents, not one giant prompt
agentOrchestration.description: Your front-desk agent hands hard tasks to specialist sub-agents, then takes the conversation back. Delegation, not a prompt nobody dares touch.

anyLlmProvider.title: Swap the brain. Keep the agent.
anyLlmProvider.description: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, Meta — switchable per agent. A better model ships Tuesday? You run it Wednesday. A dropdown, not a migration.

agentSkills.title: Write it once. Attach it anywhere.
agentSkills.description: Refund policy, tone of voice, qualification playbook — packaged as skills your agents pull in exactly when relevant. A shared skill library is coming.

versionControl.title: Publish. Pin. Roll back in one click.
versionControl.description: Every published agent is a frozen, numbered version. Bad prompt at Friday 6pm? One click back, not one lost weekend.

toolbox.title: The Toolbox: Connect to Everything
toolbox.intro: How agents reach the outside world — through an open standard, not a walled garden.

connectAnyMcp.title: If it speaks MCP, your agent speaks it
connectAnyMcp.description: MCP is the universal plug for AI tools — OpenFlow speaks it natively. Any connector becomes an agent capability. Zero glue code.

outOfTheBoxMcps.title: GitHub to Stripe, one click away
outOfTheBoxMcps.description: Around thirty pre-configured integrations: Notion, Slack, HubSpot, Linear, Figma, Zapier and more. Connecting means clicking, not reading docs.

webSearch.title: Answers from today's web
webSearch.description: Agents search the live web, read pages, explore entire sites. Built in, zero setup. No more confidently quoting last year's prices.

httpRequests.title: Coming soon: call any API, even yours
httpRequests.description: Internal tools, custom backends, the software only your client has ever heard of. If it has an endpoint, your agent will reach it.

externalSql.title: Coming soon: ask the database directly
externalSql.description: "Is it in stock?" — answered straight from your client's database, read-safe, per customer. Via database MCPs today; native and guided soon.

browserAutomation.title: Coming soon: for software with no API
browserAutomation.description: Agents that operate a real browser — navigate, click, fill, extract. The login page from 2009 stops being a dead end.

codeSandboxes.title: Coming soon: agents that run code
codeSandboxes.description: Some answers are computed, not written — crunch the spreadsheet, verify the math. Safe, disposable environments for agent-written code.

knowledge.title: The Knowledge Layer: What Agents Know
knowledge.intro: Agents that answer from your knowledge, not their guesses.

multimodalRag.title: Documents — and images — actually understood
multimodalRag.description: PDFs, Office files, web pages, images. Parsing up to full layout awareness — tables and structure respected. Not the "upload a PDF" checkbox.

kvStores.title: Prose in documents. Facts in tables.
kvStores.description: Price lists, catalogs, per-customer settings — structured records your agents read and update exactly, never approximately.

userMemory.title: Coming soon: agents that remember people
userMemory.description: Fifth conversation, same person — they should feel known, not processed. Automatic memory across conversations is on the roadmap.

revenue.title: From Conversation to Revenue
revenue.intro: Pre-built blocks that turn chats into outcomes bosses care about.

formIntegration.title: The conversation is the form
formIntegration.description: Agents collect structured data mid-chat — validated field by field, exportable to CSV. No form link where customers quietly leave.

leadScoring.title: Every chat carries a 0–100 lead score
leadScoring.description: Forty overnight conversations on Monday morning. The agent already scored them all while chatting. Sales calls the hot three first.

bookingSystem.title: Coming soon: booked before the chat ends
bookingSystem.description: A calendar link asks the prospect to cool off. Native booking lets the agent confirm the appointment inside the conversation.

payments.title: Coming soon: take payment in the chat
payments.description: The moment they say yes, the agent closes. Native checkout is on the roadmap; Stripe, PayPal, and Square work today via official integrations.

engine.title: The Engine: Always-On, Not Just On-Demand
engine.intro: Agents as running services — acting on their own schedule, not only when spoken to.

longRunningAgents.title: Coming soon: agents that work for hours
longRunningAgents.description: Most platforms kill agents after minutes — fine for chat, useless for real work. Coming: a runtime that pauses, survives restarts, and resumes.

scheduledExecution.title: Set the schedule. It fires. Every time.
scheduledExecution.description: Every morning, every hour, the first of the month — per customer, surviving deploys and outages. The daily summary that actually arrives daily.

webhookTriggers.title: Coming soon: events wake your agents
webhookTriggers.description: New signup, paid invoice, support ticket — the agent acts the moment it happens. It stops waiting to be asked.

controlRoom.title: The Control Room: See Everything, Trust Everything
controlRoom.intro: You can't sell what you can't inspect.

observability.title: "Why did it say that?" Answered in seconds.
observability.description: Every run recorded — prompts, tool calls, cost, latency — searchable across customers. Your client sends a screenshot; you send the trace.

conversationsDashboard.title: One inbox. Every customer, every channel.
conversationsDashboard.description: Read along live, take over when a moment needs a human, assign teammates, leave notes. Agents handle the volume; your people handle the moments.

evals.title: Coming soon: test before your customers do
evals.description: Run every change against a battery of scenarios and score it before publishing. Today: a rich interactive simulator. Next: automated scoring.

waysToUse.title: Ways to Use OpenFlow (and Pay for It)
waysToUse.intro: The console, the APIs, and the meter.

noCodeLowCodeApi.title: Three doors. Same platform.
noCodeLowCodeApi.description: Build visually with no code. Call any published agent as an API. Extend through custom integrations. Start where your team is.

claudeCodeMcp.title: AI-operable, not just AI-powered
claudeCodeMcp.description: OpenFlow ships as an MCP. Build, test, and publish agents from Claude Code — your AI tooling operating your AI platform.

payAsYouGoPricing.title: Priced like a cloud. Readable like a receipt.
payAsYouGoPricing.description: No seats, no plans. Each feature has a price; you pay for what you use, itemized and metered per customer. Price your own product with confidence.
